A moderation system that keeps people in control.
Stoatmod is a moderation bot for Stoat communities. It can watch the protections a server enables, apply its configured policy and preserve enough context for moderators to understand what happened.
Automatic checks do not replace human judgement. Thresholds, exclusions, moderation categories and warning escalation remain configurable by the server team.
Built for the whole moderation team
